pipeline_stages.name: sanitize_mesh
pipeline_stages.action: bmesh: delete faces with <3 vertices or area <= 1e-12 m^2; dissolve edges shorter than 1e-6 m.
pipeline_stages.policy: Only unrepairable faces are deleted. Slivers are counted and kept.
pipeline_stages.measured_effect_on_real_tiles: faces_removed = 0 on both tiles (nothing to repair)

pipeline_stages.name: recompute_normals
pipeline_stages.action: Ensure every vertex carries a usable unit normal.

pipeline_stages.name: generate_uvs
pipeline_stages.action: Per-object box projection onto the plane perpendicular to each face's dominant normal axis, normalized by that object's bounding box into [0,1].
pipeline_stages.known_limitation: Box projection is not overlap-free. Acceptable because these buildings use solid/vertex-coloured materials and claim no baked lightmap UVs. If lightmap UVs are ever needed, an overlap-aware unwrap must replace this and be re-validated.

pipeline_stages.name: apply_smoothing
pipeline_stages.action: Smooth all faces, then mark edges sharp when the dihedral angle exceeds 30 degrees; all boundary edges sharp. Uses the 4.x 'sharp_edge' boolean edge attribute with a fallback to edge.use_edge_sharp.
pipeline_stages.independent_recomputation: Recomputing the same rule from the OBJ gives 8655/13684 (63.25%) for tile 10-9 - a delta of 2 from Blender's distance-based vertex merging. Of the 5022 sub-degree (coplanar) edges, 0 were wrongly hardened.
pipeline_stages.policy_match: Hard wall corners and wall/roof intersections; smooth coplanar roof and wall faces; sharp roof ridges preserved.
pipeline_stages.threshold_is_not_a_tolerance_loophole: 30 degrees is a semantic choice about what a building corner is, independent of the 1e-12 m^2 fail-closed degeneracy threshold.

pipeline_stages.name: validate_mesh
pipeline_stages.action: Re-measure geometric and UV triangle areas with the offline gate's thresholds and return PASS / REPAIRED / REJECTED.

three_state_semantics.REPAIRED: unrepairable faces/edges removed, remainder valid (removal fraction <= 2%)
three_state_semantics.REJECTED: degeneracy survived, or >2% of faces were removed (the source mesh is untrustworthy)

pipeline_stages.on_rejected: write the manifest with gate=REJECTED, print QUALITY_GATE_FAILED, exit 2, and do NOT write an FBX
